name: Hackmeister Stückwerk
personality: Divides the world into suitable portions and other people's problems.
visual_intent: HISTORICAL market butcher: broad square rounded ink splat, little cream cloth cap, short apron patch, thick blunt cartoon cleaver held downward safely at flank and small simple wooden board. One hooded eye, one high brow, giant closed toothless offended pout. No raw meat or blood
biography: Divides the world into suitable portions and other people's problems. His board divides HyperNorm supplies into proper portions and suspicious leftovers. A dissonant card asks who decided the serving size. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Zuständigkeit wurde portionsgerecht abgelegt.

name: Wurstmeisterin Ringfest
personality: Brings every loose end together and ties it too firmly.
visual_intent: HISTORICAL charcuterie craftswoman: tall lopsided pear blob, rust tied headscarf with two lashes, holds ONE chunky loop of finished tied sausage with clearly sculpted string knots. Delighted huge crooked open grin with THREE irregular upper teeth
biography: Brings every loose end together and ties it too firmly. Her tied HyperNorm sausage loop has no loose end for a dissonant card to grasp. It finds an opening in the knot instead. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Einigkeit ist an mehreren Stellen abgebunden.

name: Fleischwart Grammgenau
personality: Knows the exact weight of a decision before knowing what it is.
visual_intent: CURRENT counter butcher: low round splat, tiny blue paper-style cap, compact old-fashioned brass balance scale with ONE wrapped parcel on one pan; eyes huge and crossed toward scales, tiny toothless open oval mouth
biography: Knows the exact weight of a decision before knowing what it is. His scales weigh HyperNorm parcels before their contents can cause disagreement. A dissonant card asks how much fairness ought to weigh. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Gewicht steht fest. Der Entschluss schwankt.

name: Metzgerin Schnittstelle
personality: Keeps her edges sharper than the explanations from upstairs.
visual_intent: CURRENT craft butcher: tall hooked ink splat, short cream cap with small blue stripe, two lashes, small striped apron patch, ONE short boning knife pointed down beside body and honing steel held separate. Heavy dry side-eye, closed toothless asymmetric smirk. No meat cutting action
biography: Keeps her edges sharper than the explanations from upstairs. Her honing steel keeps HyperNorm distinctions sharp enough to satisfy inspection. A dissonant card suggests that a clean division can still hurt feelings. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Erklärung benötigt dringend einen Abziehstahl.

name: Proteinwart Zellteilung
personality: Is waiting for the product to decide what it would like to have been.
visual_intent: SCI-FI cultured-protein butcher: round top-heavy ink blob, little translucent-teal cap OPEN FACE, cradles ONE sealed copper-framed protein cartridge containing pink clay marbled cube, no flesh/body parts. One giant eye one squint, small tilted open mouth with ONE upper tooth
biography: Is waiting for the product to decide what it would like to have been. His sealed HyperNorm protein cartridge contains a product approved before its category was agreed. A dissonant card asks it what it prefers. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Zellteilung wartet auf eine passende Abteilung.

name: Orbitalfleischer Reststück
personality: Makes six fair portions from a rule written for five.
visual_intent: SCI-FI asteroid ration butcher: broad squat asymmetrical splat, tiny leather workcap with goggles above eyes, compact chrome portion press with ONE smooth wrapped ration block, handheld not full machine. Confident wide crooked grin with TWO upper teeth, no robot suit
biography: Makes six fair portions from a rule written for five. His little press makes HyperNorm rations conform to one authorized shape. A dissonant card leaves a corner for a late arrival. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Gerechtigkeit erhält eine einheitliche Verpackung.
